notes.title: Shoot The Zombirds VR - release date
notes.notes:
The wait will soon be over, dear fans!

Shoot The Zombirds VR will be released on 28th of October, 2021! Just in time for the Halloween!
If you haven't already, be sure to add it to your wishlists so you don't miss out on the release day.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1033000/Shoot_The_Zombirds_VR
